Module com.example.miniproyecto_batalla_naval
Package com.example.miniproyecto_batalla_naval.patterns

Class RandomShotStrategy

java.lang.Object
com.example.miniproyecto_batalla_naval.patterns.RandomShotStrategy
All Implemented Interfaces:
ShotStrategy
public class RandomShotStrategy extends Object implements ShotStrategy
Shot strategy that selects valid targets randomly. This strategy chooses random cells from the opponent's board until it finds one that has not been shot previously. It is intended as a simple implementation of the ShotStrategy interface.
